name: Westgate Mall
summary: Westgate Mall is Brockton's regional shopping destination featuring over 70 shops and restaurants, offering familiar retailers, local services, and casual dining in an unassuming indoor mall setting. The center serves as a community hub with seasonal events and convenient amenities for southeastern Massachusetts shoppers.
demographics: Westgate Mall serves the greater Brockton area, attracting a diverse, value-conscious demographic with a mix of middle-income families and young adults. The trade area encompasses southeastern Massachusetts communities with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $85,000, including significant Hispanic and African American populations. Primary shoppers are budget-minded families seeking affordable fashion, dining, and entertainment options, with peak traffic on weekends and evenings. The center draws from a 15-mile radius including Brockton, Bridgewater, and surrounding suburban communities looking for convenient one-stop shopping.
description: Westgate Mall has served as Brockton's premier shopping destination since its opening, offering the community a comprehensive retail experience under one roof. Located at 200 Westgate Drive in Brockton, Massachusetts, this regional shopping center features over 70 shops and restaurants, providing visitors with a diverse mix of national retailers, local services, and casual dining options. The mall operates Monday through Thursday from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM, with extended hours until 8:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays, and Sunday hours from noon to 6:00 PM. Beyond shopping, Westgate Mall serves as a community gathering place, hosting seasonal events and offering guest services that enhance the visitor experience. With convenient access, ample parking, and a family-friendly atmosphere, Westgate Mall continues to be a vital retail and social hub for southeastern Massachusetts residents seeking value, variety, and convenience in their shopping experience.
